notes: Verified by running, not just reading: `go vet` clean, full `go test ./internal/... ./cmd/...` green against a real postgres:16 container (VENDRA_TEST_DSN), and the full web vitest suite green (13 files / 54 tests).

Tests do verify the change. internal/httpapi/contactfield_test.go:30 TestEveryStoredContactDetailIsOne is an AST sweep that requires a valid*(Phone|Website|ContactDetails) call in any function whose SQL writes the phone/website column — it could not pass before validPhoneFields/validWebsiteFields existed. TestARejectedContactDetailNamesTheBox calls the new validators directly with real accept/reject/normalise tables. web/src/pages/portal-profile.test.tsx:87 asserts input.checkValidity()===true; I confirmed independently that jsdom 30 does enforce type="url" (returns false for "www.bidder.test"), so that assertion genuinely fails on the pre-fix markup.

internal/httpapi/rows.go:318 maxPhoneLen drops the bound on phone from maxIdentifierLen (200) to 40 runes and adds minPhoneDigits=8. Legacy rows holding several numbers in one box (e.g. "02-1234-5678 / 02-1234-5679 / 010-1234-5678" = 43 chars) or a note now make any PATCH fail, and both the buyer's form (web/src/pages/Suppliers.tsx:516) and the portal's re-send the pre-filled value. Both forms do display the API message and it names the box, so it is recoverable, but no backfill or survey of existing suppliers.phone accompanies the tightening.

The lock-out the commit message describes is only half removed. If the buyer stored a website that is not an address at all ("사내 위키 - 자재부"), the supplier's 회사 연락정보 수정 still cannot save a phone correction without rewriting somebody else's value — internal/httpapi/portal.go:41 validates the whole body. The PR removes the browser-side half (type="url" on a bare host), which is the common case.

internal/httpapi/rows.go:441 isHostname is ASCII-only, so an IDN written in its native form (회사.한국) is refused. Slightly at odds with the "Vendra registers overseas suppliers" rationale used to justify the permissive phone rule; punycode still works.

web/src/pages/Portal.tsx:1217 PortalContactForm.submit still has no try/catch, and this PR gives that form a new way to be rejected (contact phone shape, internal/httpapi/portal.go:91). It is covered by the global unhandledrejection toast in web/src/feedback.tsx:52 — which also means the commit message's "left the modal open saying nothing at all" about the profile form was an overstatement; a toast did appear. The inline error is still an improvement.

web/src/pages/Portal.tsx:1375 the new <div className="form-error"> omits the role="alert" that the sibling usages (Suppliers, Approvals, Admin) carry, so a screen reader is not told about the rejection. Style-level only.
Revert-safe: no migration, no external state. The only persisted side effect is write-time normalisation of website to scheme+lowercased host, which remains a valid value if the code is rolled back.
